    async def protocol(lh: LiquidHandler):
    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    Args:
        lh (LiquidHandler): The liquid handler instance for performing operations
    """

    # ==================================================================
    # VARIABLE & CONTROL OPERATIONALIZATION
    # ==================================================================
    # Independent variable : Treatment compound (T1-T4), stocks held in
    #                        source_plate wells A1-A4 (10 uL added/well)
    # Dependent variable   : endpoint readout (measured downstream, not here)
    #
    # CONTROLS:
    #   * Vehicle control   : interior columns 2-3 -> buffer only (trough A1)
    #   * Positive control  : interior columns 8-9 -> source_plate A5 stock
    #   * Blank controls    : perimeter edge wells -> buffer only
    #
    # CONFOUNDING FACTORS (operationalized):
    #   * Edge/evaporation effects  -> all perimeter wells filled with
    #     buffer and flagged as non-analytical evaporation blanks
    #   * Positional bias           -> treatment conditions randomly
    #     assigned across the treatment block (fixed seed = reproducible)
    #   * Cross-contamination       -> fresh tip used per condition/stock
    #   * Pipetting variability     -> 6 technical replicates per condition
    #
    # VOLUMES: all aspirations <= 40 uL to fit the 50 uL tip capacity.
    # ==================================================================

    import random

    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    BUFFER_WELL = trough["A1"]        # vehicle / assay buffer channel
    BUFFER_VOL = 40                   # uL base volume per well
    TREAT_VOL = 10                    # uL treatment addition per well
    POS_CTRL_STOCK = source["A5"]     # positive control stock location

    # ---------------- Experimental layout (name-based) ----------------
    rows = "ABCDEFGH"
    all_names = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in range(1, 13)]

    # Edge wells (confounder: evaporation/thermal edge effects)
    edge_names = set(
        [f"A{c}" for c in range(1, 13)]
        + [f"H{c}" for c in range(1, 13)]
        + [f"{r}1" for r in "BCDEFG"]
        + [f"{r}12" for r in "BCDEFG"]
    )
    interior_names = [n for n in all_names if n not in edge_names]

    def col_of(name):
        return int(name[1:])

    # Assign experimental groups within the interior block
    vehicle_names = [n for n in interior_names if col_of(n) in (2, 3)]
    treatment_block_names = [n for n in interior_names if 4 <= col_of(n) <= 7]
    positive_names = [n for n in interior_names if col_of(n) in (8, 9)]
    reserve_names = [n for n in interior_names if col_of(n) in (10, 11)]

    # Randomize condition assignment within the treatment block to
    # neutralize positional gradients (fixed seed for reproducibility)
    random.seed(42)
    shuffled = list(treatment_block_names)
    random.shuffle(shuffled)
    conditions = ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"]
    assignment = {
        cond: shuffled[i * 6:(i + 1) * 6]   # 6 technical replicates each
        for i, cond in enumerate(conditions)
    }

    # ---------------- Sequential tip tracking ----------------
    tip_seq = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in range(1, 13)]
    tip_i = [0]

    def next_tip():
        name = tip_seq[tip_i[0]]
        tip_i[0] += 1
        return tip_rack[name]

    # ---------------- Phase 1: base buffer (vehicle) to all 96 wells ----------------
    # One tip reused for the whole plate (single homogeneous reagent).
    # Edge wells simultaneously serve as evaporation blank controls.
    await lh.pick_up_tips(next_tip())
    for name in all_names:
        await lh.aspirate(BUFFER_WELL, vols=[BUFFER_VOL])
        await lh.dispense(dest[name], vols=[BUFFER_VOL])
    await lh.drop_tips()
    # Vehicle control wells (cols 2-3) and reserve wells (cols 10-11)
    # now contain buffer only -> they are complete after this phase.

    # ---------------- Phase 2: randomized treatment additions ----------------
    # Fresh tip per condition prevents cross-condition contamination.
    for i, cond in enumerate(conditions):
        stock = source[f"A{i + 1}"]     # T1-T4 stocks in source A1-A4
        await lh.pick_up_tips(next_tip())
        for name in assignment[cond]:
            await lh.aspirate(stock, vols=[TREAT_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dest[name], vols=[TREAT_VOL])
            # In-well homogenization (confounder control: mixing bias)
            await lh.mix(dest[name], vols=[BUFFER_VOL], repeats=3)
        await lh.drop_tips()

    # ---------------- Phase 3: positive control addition ----------------
    await lh.pick_up_tips(next_tip())
    for name in positive_names:
        await lh.aspirate(POS_CTRL_STOCK, vols=[TREAT_VOL])
        await lh.dispense(dest[name], vols=[TREAT_VOL])
        await lh.mix(dest[name], vols=[BUFFER_VOL], repeats=3)
    await lh.drop_tips()

    # ---------------- Design summary ----------------
    print("Experimental layout operationalized:")
    print(f"  Edge blanks (buffer only)   : {len(edge_names)} wells")
    print(f"  Vehicle controls (buffer)   : {len(vehicle_names)} wells -> {vehicle_names}")
    for i, cond in enumerate(conditions):
        print(f"  {cond} (source A{i + 1})          : {len(assignment[cond])} replicates -> {assignment[cond]}")
    print(f"  Positive control (source A5): {len(positive_names)} wells -> {positive_names}")
    print(f"  Reserve (buffer only)       : {len(reserve_names)} wells")
    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
